money.panel.rationale: revenue aggregates; SEARCH has no need; EXECUTION reads it to avoid claiming unverified money

model.complete.rationale: EXTERNAL_READ; no-spend, free providers only; output UNTRUSTED. Ships DISABLED until the owner picks providers (decision D5)

pcc.agenda.rationale: owner's personal tasks/reminders; no identified agent need

pcc.add.rationale: writes to the owner's personal command center; no identified agent need

pcc.complete.rationale: closes owner's items; no identified agent need

pcc.summary.rationale: counts only, but personal data; denied with the rest of pcc.*

media.inspect_document.rationale: metadata/privacy flags of stored documents; customer material

kp.list.rationale: tool itself limits to projects the role may use

kp.search.rationale: cited passages from permitted knowledge projects

research.open_question.rationale: research writes belong to SEARCH only

research.add_source.rationale: records already-retrieved web text; untrusted content, size-capped by policy

research.declare_contradiction.rationale: only the owner can resolve it

sandbox.run_process_only.rationale: no OS isolation; EXECUTION may only ask; each call needs a signed owner approval bound to the exact arguments

obs.observe.rationale: text only, never secrets/raw media; screened; tenant/consent cannot be injected

obs.recall.rationale: PUBLIC/PERSONAL only, screened ALLOW; CONFIDENTIAL never visible

obs.correct.rationale: only agent-created observations; old text stays owner-only history

obs.capture_research.rationale: stores VERIFIED findings as memory; research-side tool

voice.status.rationale: no agent workflow needs it; agents can never speak, listen or approve

effort.choose.rationale: NEW after package v1 - DENY until the owner approves: pure policy, no data access; recommended ALLOW for both roles once approved (decision D11)

analyst.analyze.rationale: NEW after package v1 - DENY until the owner approves: deterministic CSV statistics, no code execution; recommended ALLOW for EXECUTION once approved (D11)
